jobs.title: Engineering Planner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced Maintenance Planner / Scheduler who confidently coordinates maintenance and troubleshooting activities in a GMP-regulated environment, effectively collaborates with production and workshop teams, and brings strong expertise in maintenance planning, SAP PM, and resource coordination, in order to ensure reliable, compliant, and on-time execution of maintenance activities for facilities, utilities, and equipment.

Start date: 01.06.2026
End date: 31.10.2026
Workload:100%
Contract Type: Contracting
Location: Visp

Your Tasks:

• Create and maintain maintenance schedules for facilities, utilities, and equipment

• Ensure maintenance tasks are completed on time and escalate delays when required

• Coordinate manpower, resources, and external contractors

• Manage procurement and allocation of spare parts, materials, and consumables

• Prepare KPI reports and maintenance performance reports

• Ensure all maintenance activities are performed safely and in compliance with GMP requirements

• Continuously improve planning and scheduling processes

Your Profile:

• Technical or engineering qualification (HND/HNC or equivalent)

• Experience in maintenance planning and engineering maintenance activities

• Ideally experience in pharmaceutical, GMP, or highly regulated environments

• Strong knowledge of maintenance planning and scheduling processes

• SAP PM experience required

• Fluent in German and English

jobs.description:
For our client in the Basel region, we are looking for an experienced, motivated, and open-minded Senior SAP QM Solution Architect (LIMS & Quality Automation) .

As part of a strategic digital transformation initiative, you will play a key role in shaping the future of quality assurance. In this position, you will design and develop innovative end-to-end processes for the automated handling of laboratory testing and quality certificates within the SAP environment.

Your responsibilities:

• Analyze existing quality management and laboratory processes and define future-state processes for automated inspection lot and certificate handling

• Develop a comprehensive business and IT blueprint for the integration of SAP QM with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) and external testing laboratories

• Design automated processes for the receipt, validation and assignment of digital quality certificates (Certificates of Analysis / CoA) to SAP inspection lots

• Create functional and technical specifications for interfaces based on APIs, EDI, IDocs and Web Services

• Prepare and support the implementation phase, including SAP QM customizing, development support, integration testing and user acceptance testing

• Plan and facilitate workshops with business stakeholders, laboratory partners and IT teams in an international environment

• Advise project leadership and key stakeholders on solution architecture, process design and SAP QM best practices

• Ensure a sustainable, scalable and future-proof solution architecture for digital quality assurance

Your profile:

• Several years of experience as a Senior SAP QM Consultant , Solution Architect or in a similar role with strong SAP QM expertise

• In-depth knowledge of quality inspection processes , inspection lot management , quality certificates and usage decision processes

• Proven experience in the design and implementation of integrations between SAP QM and LIMS systems or external testing laboratories

• Hands-on experience with the automation of quality certificates (CoA) , including receipt , validation and automated processing within SAP

• Strong track record in developing business concepts , IT concepts , blueprints and requirements specifications in SAP environments

• Excellent analytical and conceptual skills combined with a structured and solution-oriented approach

• Experience in workshop facilitation , stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration

• Fluent English language skills , both written and spoken, German is an advantage

• Diversi anni di esperienza come consulente senior SAP QM , Solution Architect o in un ruolo simile con una forte competenza SAP QM

• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione e realizzazione di integrazioni tra sistemi SAP QM e LIMS o laboratori di test esterni

Im Rahmen einer strategischen Initiative zur digitalen Transformation werden Sie die Zukunft der Qualitätssicherung maßgeblich mitgestalten. • Analysieren Sie bestehende Qualitätsmanagement- und Laborprozesse und definieren Sie zukunftsweisende Prozesse für den automatisierten Lot- und Zertifikatsumschlag

• Beratung der Projektleitung und wichtiger Stakeholder zu Lösungsarchitektur, Prozessdesign und SAP QM Best Practices

• Conseiller le leadership du projet et les principaux intervenants sur l'architecture des solutions, la conception des processus et les meilleures pratiques SAP QM

• Assurer une architecture durable, évolutive et à l'épreuve du futur pour l'assurance qualité numérique

Votre profil:

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en tant que consultant principal SAP QM , architecte de solutions ou dans un rôle similaire avec une solide expertise SAP QM

• Connaissance approfondie des processus d'inspection de la qualité , de la gestion des lots d'inspection , des certificats de qualité et des processus décisionnels d'utilisation

• Expérience éprouvée dans la conception et la mise en œuvre d'intégrations entre les systèmes SAP QM et LIMS ou des laboratoires d'essais externes

• Expérience pratique de l'automatisation des certificats de qualité (CoA), y compris la réception, la validation et le traitement automatisé au sein de SAP

• Forte expérience dans le développement de concepts d'affaires, concepts informatiques, plans et spécifications des exigences dans les environnements SAP

• Excellentes compétences analytiques et conceptuelles associées à une approche structurée et orientée vers la solution

• Expérience de la facilitation des ateliers, de la gestion des parties prenantes et de la collaboration interfonctionnelle

• Compétences linguistiques en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée, l'allemand est un avantage

jobs.title: IT Applikationsmanager 80 - 100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Position übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für zentrale Applikationen im Logistik und Warehouse Umfeld. Sie stellen deren zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher, entwickeln die Applikationslandschaft kontinuierlich weiter und fungieren als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, IT und externen Partnern.

Die Position eignet sich besonders für Personen, die Applikationen nicht nur betreuen, sondern deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv mitgestalten und sich gerne mit komplexen Prozessen und Schnittstellen auseinandersetzen.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie verantworten den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung zentraler Applikationen im Logistik und Warehouse Umfeld.

• Sie stellen die Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität der betreuten Anwendungen sicher.

• Sie analysieren Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen und begleiten deren technische Umsetzung.

• Sie koordinieren Anpassungen, Releases und Weiterentwicklungen der Applikationen.

• Sie analysieren Störungen und Problemstellungen und sorgen gemeinsam mit internen und externen Partnern für nachhaltige Lösungen.

• Sie betreuen und koordinieren Schnittstellen zwischen unterschiedlichen Systemen und Applikationen.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit den relevanten Fachbereichen, der internen IT sowie externen Dienstleistern und Softwarepartnern zusammen.

• Sie dokumentieren Anwendungen, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge und stellen einen strukturierten Wissenstransfer sicher.

• Sie wirken aktiv bei Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung der Applikationslandschaft mit.

Ihr Profil

• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Weiterbildung im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Sie bringen Erfahrung im Application Management, in der Applikationsbetreuung oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit.

• Sie verfügen über ein gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und deren Abbildung in IT Systemen.

• Erfahrung mit Applikationen im Logistik, Warehouse oder Supply Chain Umfeld ist von Vorteil.

• Sie besitzen ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse und die Zusammenarbeit verschiedener Systeme.

• Sie arbeiten strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und können technische sowie fachliche Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln.

• Sie schätzen die Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpartnern.

• Sie verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse.

Das erwartet Sie

Sie erwartet eine vielseitige Aufgabe in einem etablierten Schweizer Unternehmen mit einem anspruchsvollen und geschäftskritischen IT Umfeld. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für zentrale Applikationen und erhalten die Möglichkeit, deren Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten.

Die Funktion verbindet operative Applikationsverantwortung mit Projektarbeit, Prozessverständnis und der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und IT Spezialisten.

Si assume la responsabilità per le applicazioni centrali nell'ambiente logistico e magazzino. Garantiscono il loro funzionamento affidabile, sviluppano continuamente il paesaggio delle applicazioni e agiscono come un'interfaccia importante tra reparti, IT e partner esterni.

La posizione è particolarmente adatta per le persone che non solo supervisionano le applicazioni, ma plasmano attivamente il loro ulteriore sviluppo e amano affrontare processi e interfacce complesse.

I loro compiti

• Sei responsabile del funzionamento e dell'ulteriore sviluppo delle applicazioni centrali nell'ambiente logistico e del magazzino.

• Garantiscono la disponibilità e la stabilità delle applicazioni supportate.

• Essi analizzano i requisiti delle aree specializzate e accompagnano la loro implementazione tecnica.

• Coordinano adattamenti, release e ulteriori sviluppi delle applicazioni.

• Essi analizzano le interruzioni e i problemi e insieme a partner interni ed esterni garantiscono soluzioni sostenibili.

• Gestiscono e coordinano le interfacce tra diversi sistemi e applicazioni.

• Essi lavorano a stretto contatto con le aree specializzate rilevanti, l'IT interno, nonché fornitori di servizi esterni e partner software.

• Documentano applicazioni, processi e relazioni tecniche e garantiscono un trasferimento di conoscenze strutturato.

• Sei attivamente coinvolto in progetti per l'ulteriore sviluppo e ottimizzazione del panorama delle applicazioni.

Il tuo profilo

• hanno completato l'istruzione o la formazione in informatica, informatica aziendale o qualifiche comparabili;

• Hai esperienza nella gestione delle applicazioni, nel supporto delle applicazioni o in una funzione simile.

• Hai una buona comprensione dei processi aziendali e della loro mappatura nei sistemi IT.

• L'esperienza con applicazioni nella logistica, nel magazzino o nell'ambiente della supply chain è un vantaggio.

• Hanno una buona comprensione tecnica di interfacce, flussi di dati e la cooperazione di diversi sistemi.

• Lavorano in modo strutturato e orientato alla soluzione e possono trasmettere contesti tecnici e tecnici in modo comprensibile.

• Apprezzano la collaborazione con diversi contatti interni ed esterni.

• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

Si aspetta un compito versatile in una società svizzera consolidata con un ambiente IT esigente e business-critical. Si prende la responsabilità per le applicazioni centrali e ottenere l'opportunità di modellare attivamente il loro funzionamento e ulteriore sviluppo.

La funzione combina la responsabilità operativa delle applicazioni con il lavoro di progetto, la comprensione del processo e la cooperazione con vari dipartimenti e specialisti IT.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You assume responsibility for central applications in the logistics and warehouse environment. They ensure their reliable operation, continuously develop the application landscape and act as an important interface between departments, IT and external partners.

The position is particularly suitable for people who not only supervise applications, but actively shape their further development and like to deal with complex processes and interfaces.

Their tasks

• You are responsible for the operation and further development of central applications in the logistics and warehouse environment.

• They ensure the availability and stability of the supported applications.

• They analyse requirements from the specialist areas and accompany their technical implementation.

• They coordinate adaptations, releases and further developments of the applications.

• They analyse disruptions and problems and together with internal and external partners ensure sustainable solutions.

• They manage and coordinate interfaces between different systems and applications.

• They work closely with the relevant specialist areas, internal IT as well as external service providers and software partners.

• They document applications, processes and technical relationships and ensure a structured knowledge transfer.

• You are actively involved in projects for the further development and optimization of the application landscape.

Your profile

• they have completed education or training in computer science, business informatics or comparable qualifications;

• You have experience in application management, application support or in a comparable function.

• You have a good understanding of business processes and their mapping in IT systems.

• Experience with applications in the logistics, warehouse or supply chain environment is an advantage.

• They have a good technical understanding of interfaces, data flows and the cooperation of different systems.

• They work in a structured and solution-oriented manner and can convey technical and technical contexts in an understandable way.

• They appreciate the cooperation with different internal and external contacts.

• You have good knowledge of German.

This is what awaits you

She expects a versatile task in an established Swiss company with a demanding and business-critical IT environment. You take responsibility for central applications and get the opportunity to actively shape their operation and further development.

The function combines operational application responsibility with project work, process understanding and cooperation with various departments and IT specialists.

Position gestalten Sie die Weiterentwicklung einer zentralen CRM und Power Platform Umgebung. Sie verbinden fundiertes Architekturverständnis mit konkreter technischer Umsetzung und sorgen dafür, dass Anforderungen in skalierbare, nachhaltige und gut integrierte Lösungen überführt werden.

Die Position eignet sich besonders für Personen, die Architektur nicht nur konzipieren, sondern Lösungen auch selbst auf der Plattform realisieren möchten.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie gestalten Lösungsarchitekturen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 und der Microsoft Power Platform.

• Sie analysieren fachliche Anforderungen und überführen diese in strukturierte, skalierbare und nachhaltige Lösungen.

• Sie konzipieren und entwickeln Datenmodelle sowie Prozesslogiken weiter.

• Sie stellen das Zusammenspiel und die Wartbarkeit unterschiedlicher Lösungen innerhalb der Plattform sicher.

• Sie setzen Lösungen selbst auf Dynamics 365 und der Power Platform um.

• Sie entwickeln Workflows und Automatisierungen mit den Möglichkeiten der Power Platform.

• Sie definieren und steuern Datenflüsse zwischen verschiedenen Systemen.

• Sie konzipieren und realisieren Integrationen und Erweiterungen.

• Bei komplexeren Anforderungen können auch Azure Functions zum Einsatz kommen.

• Sie entwickeln die Plattform strukturell weiter und etablieren Standards sowie wiederverwendbare Lösungen.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

Ihr Profil

• Sie verfügen über fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM .

• Sie bringen sehr gute Kenntnisse der Microsoft Power Platform mit und haben entsprechende Lösungen bereits selbst umgesetzt.

• Sie haben Erfahrung im Solution Design oder in der Solution Architecture und können fachliche Anforderungen in technisch konsistente Lösungen übersetzen.

• Sie verfügen über ein gutes Verständnis von Systemarchitekturen, Datenstrukturen und Datenmodellen .

• Sie verstehen das Zusammenspiel von Systemen sowie die damit verbundenen Integrationen und Datenflüsse .

• Sie arbeiten gerne konzeptionell und setzen Lösungen gleichzeitig auch selbst technisch um.

• Erfahrung mit Workflows, Low Code Automatisierung und Integrationslösungen ist von Vorteil.

• Kenntnisse im Azure Umfeld, insbesondere mit Azure Functions , sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.

• Sie kommunizieren klar und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und technischen Stakeholdern zusammen.

Was Sie erwartet

Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle innerhalb eines spezialisierten Plattform Teams und erhalten die Möglichkeit, die CRM und Power Platform Landschaft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Dabei bewegen Sie sich nicht in einer reinen Architekturrolle. Sie entwickeln Lösungsansätze, treffen strukturelle Designentscheidungen und begleiten diese bis in die konkrete Umsetzung.

Sie arbeiten innerhalb eines definierten technischen Rahmens und verfügen gleichzeitig über Gestaltungsspielraum bei der fachlichen und strukturellen Ausarbeitung der Lösungen.

Das Unternehmen bietet ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit grundsätzlich drei Präsenztagen am Standort in der Region Frauenfeld und zwei Homeoffice Tagen. Projektabhängig können fixe oder zusätzliche Präsenztage erforderlich sein.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizionate l'ulteriore sviluppo di un ambiente centrale CRM e Power Platform. Combinano una solida comprensione architettonica con una concreta implementazione tecnica e assicurano che i requisiti siano trasformati in soluzioni scalabili, sostenibili e ben integrate.

La posizione è particolarmente adatta per le persone che non solo progettano l'architettura, ma vogliono anche realizzare soluzioni stesse sulla piattaforma.

I loro compiti

• Essi progettano architetture di soluzione basate su Microsoft Dynamics 365 e la piattaforma di Microsoft Power.

• Essi analizzano i requisiti professionali e li trasformano in soluzioni strutturate, scalabili e sostenibili.

• Progetterai e svilupperai ulteriori modelli di dati e logiche di processo.

• Garantiscono l'interazione e la manutenzione di diverse soluzioni all'interno della piattaforma.

• Essi implementano soluzioni stesse su Dynamics 365 e la Power Platform.

• Svilupperai flussi di lavoro e automazione utilizzando la piattaforma di alimentazione.

• Definiscono e controllano i flussi di dati tra diversi sistemi.

• Progettano e realizzano integrazioni e estensioni.

• Per esigenze più complesse, le funzioni Azure possono anche essere utilizzate.

• Sviluppano ulteriormente la piattaforma strutturalmente e stabiliscono standard e soluzioni riutilizzabili.

• Lavorano a stretto contatto con diverse aree specializzate e contatti tecnici.

Il tuo profilo

• Hai una profonda esperienza pratica con Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

• Essi portano una buona conoscenza della piattaforma di Microsoft Power e hanno già implementato le soluzioni stesse.

• Hai esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni o nell'architettura di soluzioni e puoi tradurre requisiti tecnici in soluzioni tecnicamente coerenti.

• Hanno una buona comprensione di architetture di sistema, strutture di dati e modelli di dati.

• Essi comprendono l'interazione dei sistemi, nonché le relative integrazioni e flussi di dati.

• A loro piace lavorare concettualmente e allo stesso tempo implementare soluzioni stesse tecnicamente.

• L'esperienza con flussi di lavoro, soluzioni di automazione e integrazione a basso codice è un vantaggio.

• La conoscenza nell'ambiente Azure, soprattutto con le funzioni Azure, è anche un vantaggio.

• Essi comunicano chiaramente e godono di lavorare con diverse aree specializzate e stakeholder tecnici.

Cosa aspettarsi

Si assume un ruolo centrale all'interno di un team di piattaforma specializzato e ottenere l'opportunità di modellare attivamente il paesaggio CRM e Power Platform.

Non si muove in un ruolo architettonico puro. Sviluppano soluzioni, prendono decisioni di progettazione strutturale e li accompagnano in attuazione concreta.

Essi lavorano in un quadro tecnico definito e allo stesso tempo hanno spazio per la manovra nello sviluppo tecnico e strutturale delle soluzioni.

L'azienda offre un modello di lavoro ibrido con fondamentalmente tre giorni di presenza presso il sito nella regione di Frauenfeld e due giorni di ufficio casalingo. A seconda del progetto, possono essere richiesti giorni di presenza fissi o aggiuntivi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Position you design the further development of a central CRM and Power Platform environment. They combine sound architectural understanding with concrete technical implementation and ensure that requirements are transformed into scalable, sustainable and well-integrated solutions.

The position is particularly suitable for people who not only design architecture, but also want to realize solutions themselves on the platform.

Their tasks

• They design solution architectures based on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Microsoft Power Platform.

• They analyze professional requirements and transform them into structured, scalable and sustainable solutions.

• You will design and develop further data models and process logics.

• They ensure the interaction and maintainability of different solutions within the platform.

• They implement solutions themselves on Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform.

• You will develop workflows and automations using the power platform.

• They define and control data flows between different systems.

• They design and realize integrations and extensions.

• For more complex requirements, Azure functions can also be used.

• They further develop the platform structurally and establish standards and reusable solutions.

• They work closely with different specialist areas and technical contacts.

Your profile

• You have deep practical experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

• They bring very good knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform and have already implemented corresponding solutions themselves.

• You have experience in solution design or solution architecture and can translate technical requirements into technically consistent solutions.

• They have a good understanding of system architectures, data structures and data models.

• They understand the interaction of systems as well as the associated integrations and data flows.

• They like to work conceptually and at the same time implement solutions themselves technically.

• Experience with workflows, low code automation and integration solutions is an advantage.

• Knowledge in the Azure environment, especially with Azure Functions, is also an advantage.

• They communicate clearly and enjoy working with different specialist areas and technical stakeholders.

What to expect

You take on a central role within a specialized platform team and get the opportunity to actively shape the CRM and Power Platform landscape.

You do not move in a pure architectural role. They develop solutions, make structural design decisions and accompany them into concrete implementation.

They work within a defined technical framework and at the same time have room for manoeuvre in the technical and structural development of the solutions.

The company offers a hybrid working model with basically three days of presence at the site in the Frauenfeld region and two home office days. Depending on the project, fixed or additional attendance days may be required.

jobs.title: QA Validation Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The role works closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, and clients to provide scientifically sound, documented evidence that processes will perform as required, assuring sustainable product quality. The position serves as a key QA point of contact for validation projects, product transfers, and validation strategy, while supporting compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

Location: Visp

Start date: Immediately

End date: 31.12.2026

Key Accountabilities

• Ensure critical GMP processes are validated and maintained in compliance with product requirements, process parameters, and global regulatory guidelines.

• Collaborate closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, and clients to ensure processes are supported by scientifically sound and documented evidence.

• Maintain oversight of validation activities for biotechnological manufacturing processes in a low bioburden environment.

• Support validation of manual and automated cleaning and sanitization processes.

• Oversee qualification requirements of related equipment and systems.

• Manage continuous process verification (CPV) and process validation activities.

• Act as a key QA point of contact for product transfer activities and related validation strategies.

• Prioritize and manage workload in alignment with line manager requirements and site goals.

• Perform change control and deviation impact assessments.

• Support investigations of non-conformities.

• Demonstrate understanding of cell and gene manufacturing processes, equipment, product control strategies, and low bioburden environmental assurance.

• Provide technical expertise in the review and approval of SOPs, protocols, reports, change controls, deviations, and other GMP records for QA closure.

• Participate in audits and inspections to demonstrate compliance with European and U.S. FDA regulations.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for SOPs related to Process Validation and Cleaning Validation.

• Review and approve validation documentation, including Process Validation, Cleaning Validation, and Computer System Validation (CSV) documentation.

• Participate in risk assessments.

• Support the Data Integrity Program.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Science, Biotechnology, or a related field.

• 5-7 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry within a GMP-regulated environment.

• Strong knowledge of process validation, cleaning validation, and equipment/system qualification.

• Experience with change controls, deviation management, and non-conformity investigations.

• Understanding of cell and gene manufacturing processes and low bioburden environments.

• Proficiency in English; German is a plus.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il ruolo lavora a stretto contatto con MSAT, Manufacturing e i clienti per fornire scientificamente sano, documentato la prova che i processi eseguiranno come richiesto, garantendo la qualità sostenibile del prodotto. La posizione funge da punto di contatto QA chiave per progetti di validazione, trasferimenti di prodotti e strategia di validazione, supportando al contempo la conformità durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

Posizione: Visp

Data di inizio: Immediatamente

Data di fine: 31.12.2026

Capacità di contabilità chiave

• Assicurarsi che i processi GMP critici siano convalidati e mantenuti in conformità ai requisiti del prodotto, ai parametri di processo e alle linee guida normative globali.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con MSAT, Manufacturing e clienti per garantire che i processi siano supportati da prove scientificamente solide e documentate.

• Mantenere la supervisione delle attività di validazione per i processi di produzione biotecnologica in un ambiente a bassa bioburazione.

• Sostenere la convalida dei processi di pulizia e sanificazione manuali e automatizzati.

• Controllare i requisiti di qualificazione di attrezzature e sistemi correlati.

• Gestisci la verifica continua del processo (CPV) e le attività di convalida del processo.

• Agite come punto di contatto chiave per le attività di trasferimento dei prodotti e le relative strategie di validazione.

• Priorizzare e gestire il carico di lavoro in allineamento con i requisiti del gestore di linea e gli obiettivi del sito.

• Eseguire il controllo dei cambiamenti e le valutazioni di impatto deviazione.

• Sostenere le indagini sulle non conformità.

• Dimostrare la comprensione dei processi di produzione delle cellule e dei geni, delle attrezzature, delle strategie di controllo del prodotto e della bassa assicurazione ambientale bioburden.

• Fornire competenze tecniche nella revisione e approvazione di SOP, protocolli, rapporti, controlli di cambiamento, deviazioni e altri record GMP per la chiusura di QA.

• Partecipa a audit e ispezioni per dimostrare la conformità alle normative europee e statunitensi della FDA.

• Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Servire come esperto di materia oggetto (SME) per le SOP relative alla convalida del processo e alla convalida delle pulizie.

• Valutazione e approvazione della documentazione di convalida, inclusa la convalida del processo, la convalida delle pulizie e la documentazione di convalida del sistema informatico (CSV).

• Partecipa a valutazioni di rischio.

• Supporta il Programma di Integrità dei Dati.

Qualifiche

• Laurea in Scienze, Biotecnologie, o un campo correlato.

• 5-7 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica in un ambiente regolamentato da GMP.

• Forte conoscenza della validazione del processo, la validazione della pulizia e la qualificazione di attrezzature/sistema.

• Esperienza con controlli di cambiamento, gestione delle deviazioni e indagini non conformi.

• Comprensione dei processi di produzione delle cellule e dei geni e degli ambienti a bassa bioburazione.

• La competenza in inglese; il tedesco è un plus.

Die Position dient als wichtiger QA-Kontaktpunkt für Validierungsprojekte, Produkttransfers und Validierungsstrategien und unterstützt gleichzeitig die Compliance während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

Standort: Visp

Startdatum: Sofort

Ende: 31.12.2026

Hauptbuchhaltung

• Sicherstellen, dass kritische GMP-Prozesse in Übereinstimmung mit Produktanforderungen, Prozessparametern und globalen regulatorischen Richtlinien validiert und gepflegt werden.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit MSAT, Manufacturing und Kunden zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Prozesse durch wissenschaftlich fundierte und dokumentierte Beweise unterstützt werden.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Validierungsaktivitäten für biotechnologische Herstellungsprozesse in einer Umgebung mit geringer Biobelastung.

• Unterstützung bei der Validierung von manuellen und automatisierten Reinigungs- und Desinfektionsprozessen.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Qualifikationsanforderungen für verwandte Geräte und Systeme.

• Verwalten von Continuous Process Verification (CPV) und Prozessvalidierungsaktivitäten.

• Als wichtiger QA-Kontaktpunkt für Produkttransferaktivitäten und damit verbundene Validierungsstrategien fungieren.

• Priorisieren und verwalten Sie die Arbeitslast in Übereinstimmung mit den Anforderungen des Linienmanagers und den Standortzielen.

• Durchführung von Change Control und Abweichung Impact Assessments.

• Unterstützung von Untersuchungen von Nichtkonformitäten.

• Demonstrieren Sie das Verständnis von Zell- und Genherstellungsprozessen, Ausrüstung, Produktkontrollstrategien und geringer Biolast-Umweltsicherheit.

• Bereitstellung von technischem Fachwissen bei der Überprüfung und Genehmigung von SOPs, Protokollen, Berichten, Änderungskontrollen, Abweichungen und anderen GMP-Datensätzen für die QA-Schließung.

• Nehmen Sie an Audits und Inspektionen teil, um die Einhaltung der europäischen und US-amerikanischen FDA-Vorschriften nachzuweisen.

• Unterstützung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen.

• Dienen Sie als Fachexperte (SME) für SOPs im Zusammenhang mit Prozessvalidierung und Reinigungsvalidierung.

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung der Validierungsdokumentation, einschließlich der Dokumentation zur Prozessvalidierung, Reinigungsvalidierung und Computersystemvalidierung (CSV).

• Teilnahme an Risikobewertungen.

• Unterstützen Sie das Data Integrity Programm.

Qualifikationen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft, Biotechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über Prozessvalidierung, Reinigungsvalidierung und Ausrüstungs- / Systemqualifikation.

• Erfahrung mit Change Control, Abweichungsmanagement und Non-Conformity-Untersuchungen.

• Verständnis von Zell- und Genherstellungsprozessen und Umgebungen mit geringer Biobelastung.

• Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch ist ein Plus.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce rôle travaille en étroite collaboration avec MSAT, Manufacturing et les clients pour fournir des preuves scientifiquement solides et documentées que les processus fonctionneront au besoin, assurant une qualité durable des produits. Le poste sert de point de contact pour les projets de validation, les transferts de produits et la stratégie de validation, tout en appuyant la conformité tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.

Lieu: Visp

Date de début : Immédiatement

Date de clôture: 31.12.2026

Principales responsabilités

• Veiller à ce que les processus essentiels des BPF soient validés et maintenus conformément aux exigences du produit, aux paramètres du procédé et aux lignes directrices réglementaires mondiales.

• Collaborer étroitement avec MSAT, Manufacturing et les clients pour s'assurer que les processus sont appuyés par des preuves scientifiquement solides et documentées.

• Maintenir la surveillance des activités de validation des procédés de fabrication biotechnologique dans un environnement à faible charge biologique.

• Soutenir la validation des processus de nettoyage et de désinfection manuels et automatisés.

• Surveiller les exigences de qualification des équipements et systèmes connexes.

• Gérer les activités de vérification continue des processus et de validation des processus.

• Agir comme principal point de contact de l'AQ pour les activités de transfert de produits et les stratégies de validation connexes.

• Privilégier et gérer la charge de travail conformément aux exigences des gestionnaires hiérarchiques et aux objectifs du site.

• Effectuer des évaluations de l'impact des changements et des écarts.

• Appuyer les enquêtes de non-conformité.

• Démontrer la compréhension des processus de fabrication de cellules et de gènes, de l'équipement, des stratégies de contrôle des produits et de l'assurance environnementale à faible charge biologique.

• Fournir une expertise technique dans l'examen et l'approbation des PNE, des protocoles, des rapports, des contrôles des changements, des écarts et d'autres dossiers sur les BPF pour la fermeture de l'AQ.

• Participer à des vérifications et des inspections afin de démontrer la conformité aux règlements de la FDA en Europe et aux États-Unis.

• Appuyer les initiatives d'amélioration continue.

• Servir d'expert en la matière (EMS) pour les PNE liées à la validation des procédés et à la validation du nettoyage.

• Examiner et approuver la documentation sur la validation, y compris la validation du procédé, la validation du nettoyage et la validation du système informatique (VSC).

• Participer à l'évaluation des risques.

• Appuyer le Programme d'intégrité des données.

Compétences

• Baccalauréat en sciences, en biotechnologie ou dans un domaine connexe.

• 5-7 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF.

• Forte connaissance de la validation des procédés, de la validation du nettoyage et de la qualification des équipements/systèmes.

• Expérience des contrôles du changement, de la gestion des écarts et des enquêtes sur la non-conformité.

• Compréhension des processus de fabrication de cellules et de gènes et des environnements à faible charge biologique.

• Compétence en anglais; l'allemand est un plus.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - System Development & Integration (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client Roche Diagnostics in Rotkreuz , we are looking for an experienced Systems Engineer to support the development of complex blood gas and electrolyte analysis systems. The role focuses on ensuring the successful integration of fluidics, software, instruments, biochemical sensors, and reagents into reliable diagnostic systems. You will take ownership of system-level topics such as requirements engineering, interface management, technical documentation, and change control. In addition, you will contribute to Model-Based Systems Engineering and innovative AI applications within systems engineering.

Hard Facts

• Start Date: 01.10.2026

• End Date: 31.12.2027

• Extension: Likely

• Workload: 100%

• Location: Rotkreuz

• Home Office: Maximum 20%

Tasks & Responsibilities

Core Systems Engineering & Requirements

• Own requirements engineering, requirements elicitation, and requirements management.

• Drive and coordinate the requirements change control process.

• Contribute to and author development documents, including:

• Product and technical requirements

• Traceability analyses and verification documentation

• Product risk analyses

• Configuration management documentation

• Collaborate closely on FMEAs, risk analyses, and risk assessments.

• Support system testing during design verification and validation activities.

Cross-Functional Integration & Collaboration

• Facilitate interface management and the creation of interface descriptions.

• Align and coordinate with relevant stakeholders across all systems engineering topics.

• Cooperate cross-functionally with Hardware and Software Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs.

• Collaborate on the definition, planning, and execution of project tasks and work packages.

AI & Model-Based Systems Engineering

jobs.title: Senior Category Manager (CAPEX project) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client from the Pharma manufacturing, we are looking for a Senior Category Manager, who will act as a Lead for the development and execution of category strategies for Civil and CSA packages within CAPEX projects

Your Tasks:

• Define and deploy category strategy for CSA (civil works, structural steel, buildings)

• Lead sourcing, tendering and supplier selection for CSA packages

• Drive commercial negotiations including contracts, frameworks and pricing structures

• Partner with Engineering, Construction and Project teams to ensure early procurement involvement

• Manage strategic supplier relationships and contractor performance

• Drive cost optimization, benchmarking and value engineering across projects

• Ensure risk management for construction activities (schedule, cost, HSE and supply risk)

• Ensure compliance with GMP, EHS and construction standards

• Translate category strategies into project-specific sourcing and execution plans

• Monitor contractor performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives

Your Profile:

• Degree in Engineering (Civil, Structural, Construction) or Business. Technical background strongly preferred.

• 10–15 years experience in Procurement, Category Management or Construction sourcing

• Strong experience in pharmaceutical / life sciences CAPEX projects

• Proven experience in CSA / construction sourcing

• Strong track record in complex negotiations and contract management

• Experience in large CAPEX projects (greenfield / brownfield)

• Solid understanding of construction execution, engineering and project lifecycle

• Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, Construction and Project teams

• Fluent English and German

jobs.title: Senior Qualifying Specialist (1550) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client operating in the Pharma manufacturing industry, we are looking for a Senior Qualifying Specialist

Main responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain commissioning and qualification documents for new plants, including PQs for critical systems and ongoing SLC support post-implementation.

• Supervise and resolve deviations, manage changes (GEP and GMP), and implement CAPAs effectively.

• Coordinate efforts between internal teams and external service providers and suppliers to ensure seamless project execution.

• Present qualification documents during audits and inspections, showcasing the outstanding standards maintained

Your profile:

• Graduate from a technical school (HF) / university of applied sciences (FH) or hold a university degree.

• Proven experience in a regulated GMP environment, specifically in commissioning, qualification, and validation of systems like refrigerators, freezers, clean media, and process engineering equipment.

• Strong proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with COMOS, DMS, Kneat, TrackWise, and SAP is advantageous.

• Proficient in both written and spoken German and/or English.

• Demonstrate independent, flexible work habits, with excellent communication skills and a structured, focused approach to tasks.

• Open to new ideas, agile in thinking, and proactive in problem-solving.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer/ Expert 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced Solution Engineer who will take responsibility for the architecture, development, and continuous improvement of a custom Debian-based Linux platform for medical diagnostic systems, bring strong expertise in Linux distribution engineering, Debian packaging, kernel customization, build and release automation, scripting, and low-level system troubleshooting, and leverage extensive experience in platform optimization, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional consulting to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of the next generation of Roche medical devices.

Start date: asap / latest Start date: 01.10.26

End date: 1 year (with option to extend)

Workload: 80-100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Location: Canton Zug

Home Office: max. 2 days/week

Your tasks:

•
 Architect and Engineer our Core OS Platform: Take ownership of our custom

Debian-based distribution. This includes everything from kernel customization and driver

integration to the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Debian packages

•
 Master the Build and Release Pipeline: Evolve and improve the infrastructure and

processes used to build, test, and release our Linux distribution, ensuring reliability and

reproducibility

•
 Be the Ultimate Escalation Point: Act as the go-to expert for complex, low-level

system issues. Perform deep-dive troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis

across both software and hardware

•
 Consult and Empower Development Teams: Guide internal project teams on how to

best leverage the Roche Linux platform

•
 Proactively Drive Improvement: Constantly seek out opportunities to enhance our

distribution, tools, and processes. Whether it's improving system performance,

strengthening security, or automating a complex workflow, you will be expected to

identify needs and champion solutions.

Your Profile:

•
 Deep, Hands-On Linux Mastery (10+ years): You are a seasoned professional who is comfortable across the entire Linux stack

•
 Custom Distribution Engineering: Proven, extensive experience building, modifying, or maintaining a customized Linux distribution, with a strong preference for Debian (e.g.,using tools like debootstrap, molior, aptly)

•
 Expertise in Debian Packaging: You don't just apt-get install. You can create, patch, and maintain .deb packages from scratch, understanding policy, dependencies and best practices

•
 Strong Scripting and Automation Skills: Fluency in Python and Shell scripting is essential for building tools and automating system tasks

•
 Fundamental Systems Knowledge: A solid grasp of operating system theory (process management, memory, filesystems), software build systems (make, CMake), and the full testing and packaging lifecycle

•
 Advanced English is mandatory; German is a welcome bonus

Nice to have:

•
 Proficiency in a systems programming language like C or C++

•
 Experience with embedded systems, the ARM platform, hardware drivers, and low-level hardware/software integration

•
 Knowledge of modern infrastructure: Virtualization (KVM), Containers (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

•
 Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS)
